name: docs-ux-review
description: Use when creating, editing, or reviewing README files, plugin documentation, setup guides, troubleshooting docs, developer onboarding docs, or any user-facing technical document where first-screen value, no-context reader review, concrete visual/output examples, section-level reader questions, unfamiliar terminology, official-doc links, requirements, warnings, or Korean document UX matter. 특히 README UX, 컨텍스트 없는 사용자 관점 점검, 출력 예시, 요구사항/주의사항 분리, 낯선 용어 첫 등장, official docs 링크, technical-writer 결과 검수에 사용.
